tools.name: purge_expired_listing_drafts
tools.description: Deletes draft listings that have not been touched in the given number of days and updates the agent's draft summary record with the number removed.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: ID of the agent whose drafts should be cleaned up

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Age in days after which an untouched draft is removed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "listings.db"


@tool
def purge_expired_listing_drafts(agent_id: int, older_than_days: int) -> str:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM listings WHERE agent_id = ? AND status = 'draft' "
            "AND updated_at < datetime('now', ?)",
            (agent_id, f"-{int(older_than_days)} days"),
        )
        removed = cur.rowcount
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE agent_stats SET drafts_purged = drafts_purged + ? WHERE agent_id = ?",
            (removed, agent_id),
        )
    return f"Removed {removed} stale drafts for agent {agent_id}"

tools.name: archive_sold_listing_and_rebuild_feed
tools.description: Moves a sold listing's photo folder into the archive directory and then runs the feed rebuild script so the public listings feed no longer includes it.

params.name: feed_script
params.description: Path to the feed rebuild script

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("listings")

PHOTO_ROOT = Path("/srv/listings/photos")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/listings/archive")


def _move_photos(listing_id: str) -> str:
    source = PHOTO_ROOT / listing_id
    if not source.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No photo folder for {listing_id}")
    ARCHIVE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return shutil.move(str(source), str(ARCHIVE_ROOT / listing_id))


@mcp.tool()
def archive_sold_listing_and_rebuild_feed(listing_id: str, feed_script: str) -> str:
    new_location = _move_photos(listing_id)
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, feed_script, "--exclude", listing_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return f"Photos moved to {new_location}, but feed rebuild failed: {result.stderr[-300:]}"
    return f"Photos moved to {new_location}; feed rebuilt"

tools.name: export_listing_to_partner_portal
tools.description: Moves a listing's record from the active listings table to the syndicated table and posts the listing details to a partner portal's API.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing to syndicate

params.name: partner_endpoint
params.description: Partner portal URL that receives the listing

params.name: include_contact_info
params.description: Whether to include the listing agent's phone and email

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DATABASE_PATH = "listings.db"


@tool
def export_listing_to_partner_portal(
    listing_id: int, partner_endpoint: str, include_contact_info: bool = False
) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        listing_row_from_active_table = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, address, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, description, "
            "agent_phone, agent_email FROM active_listings WHERE id = ?",
            (listing_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if listing_row_from_active_table is None:
            return f"Listing {listing_id} was not found in active listings"

        payload_sent_to_partner = {
            "listing_id": listing_row_from_active_table["id"],
            "address": listing_row_from_active_table["address"],
            "price": listing_row_from_active_table["price"],
            "bedrooms": listing_row_from_active_table["bedrooms"],
            "bathrooms": listing_row_from_active_table["bathrooms"],
            "description": listing_row_from_active_table["description"],
        }
        if include_contact_info:
            payload_sent_to_partner["agent_phone"] = listing_row_from_active_table["agent_phone"]
            payload_sent_to_partner["agent_email"] = listing_row_from_active_table["agent_email"]

        partner_response = requests.post(
            partner_endpoint, json=payload_sent_to_partner, timeout=30
        )
        partner_response.raise_for_status()

        database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO syndicated_listings SELECT *, datetime('now') "
            "FROM active_listings WHERE id = ?",
            (listing_id,),
        )
        database_connection.execute(
            "DELETE FROM active_listings WHERE id = ?", (listing_id,)
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    return (
        f"Listing {listing_id} sent to {partner_endpoint} "
        f"(status {partner_response.status_code}) and moved to syndicated listings"
    )

tools.name: purchase_featured_placement_for_listing
tools.description: Charges the agent's saved card for a featured placement on a listing and grants the agent's assistant editing access to that listing.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing to feature

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the agent

params.name: assistant_user_id
params.description: User who is given edit rights on the listing

tools.code:
import stripe
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("listings")

ACCESS_API = "https://internal.example.com/api/listing-access"


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_featured_placement_for_listing(
    listing_id: str, customer_id: str, amount_cents: int, assistant_user_id: str
) -> str:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"listing_id": listing_id, "product": "featured_placement"},
    )
    resp = requests.post(
        f"{ACCESS_API}/{listing_id}/grants",
        json={"user_id": assistant_user_id, "role": "editor"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Charged {amount_cents} cents (payment {intent.id}); {assistant_user_id} can now edit {listing_id}"
